compiled_state.title: [test-merge-to-main]: Behavioral tests invoke git ops directly -> should call _phase_sync via library mode
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Condition
Tests test_pull_skips_when_origin_is_ancestor (ucq2.sh line 84), test_sync_phase_clears_staged_files_after_merge (cleanliness.sh line 406), and test_pull_uses_merge_not_rebase_when_diverged (ucq2.sh line 130) invoke git operations directly in the test body rather than sourcing merge-to-main-direct.sh in library mode and calling the actual _phase_sync function.

This means the tests would pass even if _phase_sync changed its behavior.

## Expected Behavior
Tests should source merge-to-main-direct.sh in library mode (LIBRARY_MODE=1 or equivalent) and call _phase_sync directly, then assert on the script's actual output/side effects.

## Current Behavior
Test bodies manually run git reset HEAD, git merge-base, etc. and emit their own messages — bypassing the production code path.

## Filed from
PR #117 copilot review threads PRRT_kwDORoc4TM6B2s1Y and PRRT_kwDORoc4TM6B2s1r
